evidence: Engineered training panel has provider, coverage and SHA-256 metadata.
requirement: Every evaluated panel must carry source, coverage and content fingerprint.

requirement: Revisions must retain both the old and new raw input, not only hashes.

evidence: Feature rows are formed after close t; executable returns enter at open[t+1] and exit at open[t+6]. Tests vary close-t independently from fill prices.
requirement: A close-t signal may execute no earlier than open[t+1] (or a predeclared later price).

evidence: Prospective paper scoring enters on the next archived session and evaluates five sessions later; unit tests cover the delay.
requirement: Prospective observations must never use the signal-date close as an executable fill.

evidence: Chronological classifier refits use a six-session label embargo covering the next-open lag and five-session holding period; tests verify future labels do not alter earlier predictions.
requirement: Training labels may not overlap the unseen test block.

evidence: Reported five-session model returns are sampled every five rows and paper scorecards do not compound overlapping outcomes.
requirement: Overlapping outcomes may be described but not compounded as independent returns.

evidence: Archived evaluations deduct a fixed 0.10% one-way cost from turnover.
requirement: Every strategy comparison must deduct a visible turnover-linked cost.

evidence: The cost model does not separately represent bid-ask spread, slippage, fund fees, cash yield or tax assumptions.
requirement: New candidates need a documented base cost plus adverse cost scenarios and cash return.
